::: {#lem-solve-normal-equations-vector}
#### Solution of the normal equations in vector notation

If $\sspred > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
the matrix $A = \sumin \soprod{\vxi}$ is invertible,
and the normal equations $A \vcoef = \v{c}$ with $\v{c} = \sumin \vxi \outvar_\iobs$
(@lem-normal-equations-vector) have exactly one solution,

$$
\vcoef = A^{-1} \v{c}
= \begin{pmatrix} \outbar - \coef{x} \predbar \\ \sspredout / \sspred \end{pmatrix}
\quad \text{with} \quad \coef{x} = \frac{\sspredout}{\sspred},
$$

the same solution as @lem-solve-normal-equations.
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-solve-normal-equations-vector.

:::
